purpose: Bind A1, A2, and A3 commercial evidence into a customer-safe coverage artifact for report, review, GitHub gate, billing, audit, and redaction readiness.

coverage_summary.commercial_claim: A3 can package downstream release intelligence from A1 RunResult and A2 GradeResult evidence into report, review, GitHub, billing, audit, and redaction artifacts without changing A1 runner or A2 judge semantics.

tenant.storage_boundary: all durable rows require tenant and project scope before hosted use

auth.hosted_requirement: authenticated service identity before live refresh or publish

rbac.mutation_boundary: read-only evidence coverage until hosted RBAC exists

usage.usage_payload_policy: counts, ids, statuses, hashes, and relative paths only

artifact_types.binding: A3 consumes run id, case status, trace ids, tool-call summaries, observation ids, and usage counts as downstream evidence.
artifact_types.commercial_value: proves the release packet starts from runner evidence rather than dashboard-only claims

artifact_types.binding: A3 consumes pass state, score, failure class, threshold, judge version, and calibration references as downstream evidence.
artifact_types.commercial_value: proves the release packet includes judge evidence and does not rewrite A2 scoring

artifact_types.binding: A3 report exports combine A1 and A2 inputs with release evidence summaries and customer-readable findings.
artifact_types.commercial_value: turns raw evidence into a buyer-facing report packet

artifact_types.binding: Report Center records report inventory, manifest completeness, hosted lifecycle, and artifact count.
artifact_types.commercial_value: shows the control plane for repeated report delivery

artifact_types.binding: Review workflow records reviewer state, assignment, exception review, approval readiness, and blocked evidence.
artifact_types.commercial_value: supports enterprise sign-off before a release gate is trusted

artifact_types.binding: GitHub check readback records provider-side check status, conclusion, and stale-or-confirmed state after publish.
artifact_types.commercial_value: connects local release evidence to external merge-control evidence

artifact_types.binding: PR comment readback records marker presence, rendered summary state, and stale-or-confirmed state after publish.
artifact_types.commercial_value: proves human-readable review evidence can be reconciled after publish

artifact_types.binding: Billing readiness uses usage ledger counts for runs, imports, reports, readbacks, and artifact exports without payment mutation.
artifact_types.commercial_value: supports paid-plan usage visibility while staying read-only

artifact_types.binding: Audit bundle index hashes source and generated evidence with relative paths and verification results.
artifact_types.commercial_value: gives auditors a stable evidence packet boundary

artifact_types.binding: Redaction firewall blocks raw credentials, customer identifiers, local account paths, and signed media links before export.
Commercial evidence packet groups the previous artifact types into one customer-facing coverage receipt.
artifact_types.commercial_value: makes the minimum sellable evidence surface explicit
